model_fit_option_not_measurement.tap_rule: Do not multiply taps in proportion to length. Existing three taps are unverified and must not be reported as confirmed.

model_fit_option_not_measurement.documentation_rule: State that length was adjusted to the user's instruction within the existing model, while real dimensions and tap count remain unconfirmed.
